summary: Implement the build phase: a deterministic appbuilder checkpoint between scaffold and test. The agent writes the real code into build/<slug>/; the CLI seeds an accounting stub (build init) and then validates the agent's declared work against the plan and the files on disk (build), emitting a build-report.json for later phases. No LLM in the CLI.
goals: Replace the build placeholder with a real, deterministic phase that gates between scaffold and test.
Keep the no-LLM-in-CLI contract: the agent declares what it built; the CLI only validates the declaration.
Mirror existing framework shape — two verbs like plan (build init seeds, build validates) and a report JSON like scaffold.
Give operators a thorough HOWTO walkthrough of the build phase, not a one-liner.

features.name: build-manifest and build-report contracts
features.description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/build-manifest.schema.json (agent-authored input: tasks with status pending|done|skipped, files, reason) and build-report.schema.json (CLI-authored output: counts + files_touched), plus validateBuildManifest/validateBuildReport in cli/lib/validate.js and registration in REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES.

features.name: appbuilder build init
features.description: Seed build/<slug>/build-manifest.json from task-plan.json + scaffold-report.json with every plan task pre-listed as pending. Gate on scaffold-report.json existing; refuse to overwrite without --force.

features.name: appbuilder build validation gate
features.description: Validate the manifest against the plan and disk (ids match, no pending, done tasks list existing files, skipped tasks carry a reason, scaffold files not regressed) and write a schema-valid build-report.json on pass; fail loudly and write nothing otherwise.

features.name: build phase documentation
features.description: Document the build phase thoroughly: a full operator walkthrough in HOWTO.md (both verbs, the manifest the agent fills, failure modes, place in the loop), plus README.md and CLI help-text updates.

constraints: No LLM in the CLI; build never generates code, only seeds a stub and validates.
Zero new runtime dependencies; use node: built-ins and the existing custom schema validator.
Follow the existing cli/lib/* module pattern and the scaffold/plan phase shapes.
Tasks share tests/appbuilder.test.js, so merges serialize one PR at a time.
Do not change scaffold, plan, or coordination behavior; start/test/review/ship stay placeholders.
